subject.name: CBGB & OMFUG
subject.poc_goal: Build a provenance-first historical digital twin using only reusable assets for reconstruction and reference-only records for corroboration.

rights_classes.A: Owned or newly captured by the project; suitable for commercial reconstruction.
rights_classes.B: Partner supplied with explicit commercial derivative rights.
rights_classes.C: Open/public-domain material; usable only under the exact source license and attribution/share-alike obligations.
rights_classes.D: Reference-only evidence. Keep metadata/link; do not copy into reconstruction training or textures without additional permission.
rights_classes.E: Restricted/prohibited source. Do not scrape, download, train on, or derive production geometry/textures from it.

sources.title: The Bowery Historic District - National Register of Historic Places registration report
sources.use: Authoritative geometry/history corroboration. The report identifies 313-315 Bowery as two 1878 tenements joined in 1934, with a four-story four-bay Art Deco facade; it also documents the Palace Bar/Hotel and CBGB history and states the club interior was largely preserved after closure.

sources.title: Wikimedia Commons - CBGB 2009 interior category
sources.use: Primary open-licensed interior visual evidence. Category currently contains 12 photographs. The collector verifies each file license before download.

sources.title: Wikimedia Commons - CBGB category
sources.use: Exterior, stage, post-closure and performance evidence. Licenses vary by file; collector downloads only an allow-listed open license and records attribution.

sources.title: CBGB, 1974 May 05 - Cornell Punk Flyers
sources.use: Timeline, signage, typography, performers and event graph. Cornell states the image is protected by copyright and made available for non-profit educational use; do not ingest into commercial reconstruction without permission.

sources.title: CBGB - Cynthia MacAdams, 1986 - NYPL Digital Collections
sources.use: Historical visual reference and timeline corroboration. NYPL identifies the item as copyright protected; metadata only unless permission is obtained.

sources.title: Punk Photographer Roberta Bayley - Museum of the City of New York
sources.use: Oral-history/context evidence about the room, performances and 1970s scene; linked photographs remain reference-only unless separately licensed.

prohibited_reconstruction_sources.rule: May be used only as allowed by its terms for viewing/navigation; do not scrape or create production 3D derived assets from it.

prohibited_reconstruction_sources.source: Unlicensed social-media, press, YouTube or commercial photography
prohibited_reconstruction_sources.rule: Keep URL, date, creator and observations as reference evidence only until commercial derivative permission is documented.
